newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil bucks weak trend.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil bucks weak trend.

text.p: NWE oil products on Tuesday saw gasoline and fuel oil down but gas oil up, traders said.
Gasoline fell $3-$5 after Monday's selloff in New York but activity was thin ahead of the APIs.
Naphtha was steady after crude rose slightly and some focus turned to year-end strategies to keep inventories low, which could limit end-user buying.
Gas oil rose $1.50 with futures but colder weather left buyers unmoved and premiums were mostly unchanged.
Fuel oil barges slumped $5 on aggressive selling by a trading company, but the U.S. arbitrage was widening.
